notes.title: New Releases - Bohemia Interactive Titles
notes.content:
Four new games from Bohemia Interactive are now available on on Steam and 10% off until November 12th.

• Pound of Ground – crazy story driven 3rd person action shooter with tons of zombies.
• Alternativa – classic adventure game set in a dark future.
• Pat & Mat – a kid's puzzle game based on a popular animated TV series.
• Fish Fillets 2 - cult puzzle title with two fish secret agents.

Developed by Centauri Production, Pound of Ground, Alternativa and Pat & Mat include Steam Cloud support plus Pound of Ground also adds 26 new Steam Achievements to collect.
